status: draft: not yet filed. Filing = operator fills decision_date and the campaign search size, commits this file, and records the commit BEFORE any E-1 result is read. No gate threshold in validation/gates.py changes until the filed study has been run and its decision rule applied.
experiment: E-1: pipeline power and size study of the promotion gates
question: At the real campaign search size, how often does the full validation ladder with GATE_SET_V2 promote a candidate that has NO edge (size), and how often does it promote one with a small real edge (power)?

hypotheses.H0_size: With per-trade Sharpe 0 injected, the campaign-level probability that at least one candidate is promoted (family-wise size) is at most 0.05.
hypotheses.H1_power: With per-trade Sharpe 0.08 injected into one candidate of the campaign, the probability that it is promoted is at least 0.50.
hypotheses.note: Both are claims about the PROCEDURE (ladder + gates + deflation with the ledger's trial count), not about any strategy. A gate set that fails H0 is too lax; one that fails H1 at acceptable size is too strict for edges of the size the platform can plausibly find.

injected_sharpe_grid.unit: per-trade Sharpe ratio (mean / sd of per-trade return), not annualised

data_generating_processes.name: block_bootstrap_real_returns
data_generating_processes.definition: Per-trade net returns of the five seed documents on the validated HistData universe (engine_v3_realism, GBP account, IG_REALISTIC), stationary-block-bootstrapped (Politis-Romano, block length from optimal_block_length) to remove any edge, demeaned, then shifted by sr * sd so the injected per-trade Sharpe is exactly sr. The parameter surface is kept by applying the same shift to every grid point within one grid step of the declared defaults and a linearly decaying shift beyond.
data_generating_processes.status: not implemented in the skeleton: scripts/gate_power_study.py raises NotImplementedError for this source until the validated universe is ingested

data_generating_processes.name: perturbed_price_paths
data_generating_processes.definition: Real OHLC paths with their log returns block-bootstrapped (destroying serial structure a strategy could exploit) and the documents re-run through the real engine; the edge is injected by a known deterministic signal overlay whose per-trade Sharpe is sr.

data_generating_processes.name: synthetic_gaussian_plateau
data_generating_processes.definition: Per-period returns mu(params) + sd * (sqrt(c) * common + sqrt(1 - c) * idiosyncratic), c = 0.7, mu = sr * sd at the declared defaults decaying linearly in grid steps. Used ONLY to exercise the harness and for the tiny-scale test; it is not evidence for or against any threshold.

search_size.rule: Each simulated campaign has the same number of candidates and grid points per candidate as the largest campaign run on real data at filing time, and every candidate's ladder receives external_trial_count = (campaign trials - its own), exactly as discovery.campaign does.

replicates.rule: 400 simulated campaigns per (sr, data-generating process) cell; the size estimate's Monte Carlo SE at 0.05 is sqrt(0.05 * 0.95 / 400) = 0.0109. If the size point estimate lies within 2 SE of 0.05, double the replicates for that cell once and report both.

primary: size = P(any candidate promoted | sr = 0), per data-generating process
power(sr) = P(the injected candidate is promoted | sr), sr in {0.03, 0.05, 0.08, 0.12}
secondary: per-gate rejection rates at each sr (which gate binds)
distribution of the deflated Sharpe, PBO and SPA p-value at sr = 0
wall-clock per ladder run, for planning

decision_rule: 1. If size <= 0.05 and power(0.08) >= 0.5 on BOTH real-data processes: keep GATE_SET_V2 unchanged and record the measured size and power beside it. 2. If size > 0.05 on either process: tighten ONLY the gate(s) whose removal most reduces size, choosing the smallest change that brings size to <= 0.05; do not loosen any gate in the same step. 3. If size <= 0.05 but power(0.08) < 0.5: candidate loosenings are the section 3.1 proposals (MinTRL-based min_trades, plateau median rule, WFE on log growth, 8-fold OOS hit rate); each is admitted only if size stays <= 0.05 with it. 4. The result, whatever it is, is published as GATE_SET v2.1.0-calibrated with this file's commit as its provenance, BEFORE any real strategy is re-scored against it. 5. No threshold is chosen by looking at how a real strategy scores.
data_rules: Real returns are taken from engine_v3_realism backtests only; engine_v2 records are superseded.
The holdout segment of every dataset version is excluded from the bootstrap source.
Seeds are fixed in the script and recorded in the output; a re-run must reproduce the output byte for byte.
